Why billing errors happen

Complex commercial billing structures can hide overcharges for years.

Commercial Ameren billing structures involve layered tariffs, classifications, demand calculations, riders, usage patterns, and account history. Errors and misclassifications can persist unnoticed for years. Most businesses reasonably assume the original billing structure was correct and never independently reviewed.

Contingency-based recovery

No upfront cost. No recovery, no fee.

We only get paid when you do. Our fee is 50% of whatever we recover, money that didn't exist for you before we found it. If we find nothing, you owe us nothing.

  • You pay nothing upfront
  • We handle everything — time, effort, and all recovery costs
  • You keep 50% of every recovery
  • No recovery means no charge, ever

FAQ

Common questions.

Is this about switching suppliers or lowering future rates?

No. We are not an energy supplier and this is not a rate-switching pitch. Our review is backward-looking and focused on identifying recoverable billing errors from prior Ameren billing cycles, looking back up to 36 months.

Do I need old bills?

No. With a simple authorization form, we request billing records directly from Ameren. You do not have to find or sift through any old billing records.

How long does the process take?

The audit itself typically takes approximately 2 to 5 weeks. After the audit is completed, the overall timeline becomes dependent on Ameren’s internal review and recovery process, as well as the complexity of the specific billing issues identified.

What types of accounts qualify?

Commercial and industrial accounts with meaningful historical billing activity are typically the best fit.

Why wouldn’t businesses already know about this?

Commercial utility billing structures can be highly technical and may remain unchanged for years unless independently reviewed. Many businesses reasonably assume the original account setup, classifications, and billing structures were correct.

Can we sign an NDA?

Yes. We’re happy to sign an NDA upon request.

Is there any upfront cost?

None. You never pay anything upfront or out of pocket. We are paid only from successfully recovered funds.

What happens if nothing is found?

There is no fee. You gained certainty without spending time, effort, or money.

What if the utility issues a credit instead of a refund check?

Some recoveries may be issued as account credits rather than direct checks. In those cases, payment arrangements are structured from the recovered funds. If nothing is recovered, nothing is owed.
